reviews.observations: Rejected this card once before accepting it. The first submission passed every doneWhen and carried three assertions that could not fail: clause (8) filtered its expectation to ids the bundle already held and then asserted containment, clause (3) cast half compared two calls that both ignored their second argument on reverted code, and four clauses exercised bindInitialSceneContents, a planner with no production caller. The repair was to make each counterweight compare something that can differ, and clause (8) now compares the no-selection bundle field-for-field against createEdChestPainLocalLearnerRuntimeAssetBundle(). A second defect surfaced during the repair and was fixed: injecting a document emptied equipment and equipmentPlacements for ward_delirium_med_rec_v1 and clinic_knee_pain_return_to_play_v1, because silence was being read as refusal; the rule was inverted. The recorded RED diagnosis was also wrong and was corrected in three places: it blamed castFromScenarioBank returning an empty array, but the route never reached that code because it called the bundle constructor with no arguments at all. For this report the counterweight was re-measured with a MINIMAL in-scope falsifier rather than the rest route, which this card does not own: reverting only packages/openclinxr/asset-registry/src/actor-casting.ts to 9a7135fc and rebuilding asset-registry produced 5 failed / 4 passed with the ED cast served for a ward case, and restoring produced 9 passed / 0 failed. Both runs are captured as artifacts and their vitest tallies were read back off the captured bytes rather than off the child process return value. Owner reruns at the integrated head: regression suites 15/15, placement node 5/5, behavior test 9/9, assert-contract-live 1 contract live, verifier suite 16/16. Ratchets unmoved: main.ts exactly 4822, runtime-bundles.ts 1621 under its 1638 freeze, schemas.ts 497 under its 500 zone budget, ward case unchanged at c8b7ac01.
